notes: This is a 2-piece HDBaseT extender set (Transmitter + Receiver); ports from both units are listed together and labeled TX/RX for clarity. HDMI is HDCP 2.2 capable with DVI/D support via adapter (not included); WyreStorm does not state an explicit HDMI version number, and given max pixel clock of 340MHz / 4K60 4:2:0 support, an hdmi-2.0-class grade is plausible but not confirmed in the datasheet, so grade is omitted per the no-inference rule. HDBaseT (RJ45) is proprietary Class C signaling (10.2Gbps encoding rate), not standard Ethernet, so no eth-* grade applies and none is set. USB is 1x Type B host port (Transmitter) and 4x Type A device ports (Receiver), spec'd as USB 2.0 with max throughput 190Mbps over the link. RS-232 uses 3-pin Phoenix/terminal-block connectors on both Transmitter and Receiver (mapped to euroblock, the closest listed connector). Audio in/out on both ends are 3.5mm TRS stereo. DC power input on both TX and RX is a locking barrel-style jack fed by the included 12V DC 2A external power supply (mapped to dc-barrel). Unit is documented as "<1U" and is a small desktop/wall-mountable enclosure, not intended for rack mounting, so rackUnits is omitted. Source: WyreStorm official specification sheet (PDF rev 210507, mirrored at cdn-docs.av-iq.com), content consistent with the manufacturer's own product page.
